publication.title: Shadow Theory and Consciousness: Awareness, Perspectival Realization, and the Source-to-Experience Problem
publication.author: Jeremy Rodgers

provenance.method: Genuine separately supplied final LaTeX, matched to the archival PDF; bibliography extracted from its embedded filecontents block.

adaptations: Five part dividers are retained as contents groups and source-label anchors on their opening chapters; the unnumbered technical appendices divider introduces the appendix group.
The printed contents is replaced by linked web navigation. Repeated long-table headings remain preserved.
Bibliography numbers and entry identities follow the archival PDF; field typography and name presentation derive deterministically from the embedded source bibliography.
KaTeX supplies visual HTML and accessible MathML. Original mathematical macros expand in Markdown; displayed equation numbering is retained.
Bibliography backlinks are explicitly navigational web additions.
